{{For|the item part of the Foraging Collection|Spruce Log}}
The '''Spruce Woods''' is a sub-location of [[The Park]].

{{ZoneText|Chop down Spruce logs.}}

== Features ==
The '''Spruce Woods''' features a few attractions.

=== Kelly ===
{{Main|Kelly}}
{{NPCSprite|Kelly}} is an [[NPC]] located right in the middle of the '''Spruce Woods'''. They are part of the "A Helping Hand" [[Quests|Quest]], and require the player to chop down {{Item|Spruce Log|amount=128}}s. The player will be rewarded for completing the quest with {{Item|Kelly's T-Shirt}}, {{Coins|1,500}}, {{Skill XP|+500 Foraging}}, and access to the {{Zone|Dark Thicket}}.

=== Woods Racing ===
{{Main|Woods Race}}
The [[Woods Race]] is an ongoing quest that begins once the player talks to {{NPCSprite|Gustave}}. The player must run over a pressure plate next to {{NPCSprite|Gustave}} in the '''Spruce Woods''' before crossing over to the {{Zone|Dark Thicket}}, followed by the {{Zone|Savanna Woodland}} and {{Zone|Jungle Island}} and run over another pressure plate, before returning to the original one to end the race. Completing races under certain amounts of time yields unique items.
